title: Gulf Front Rosemary Beach 3BR Rental with Beach Access
meta_description: At Atwoods Cottage & Carriage House, you simply can’t get any closer to our beautiful beach. With a separate carriage house for that little dash of extra space, your whole family can spread out and easily sink their toes in the sand anytime they wish.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Atwoods Cottage & Carriage House
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionRosemary Beach is famous for its magical coastal location and pristine Gulf Of Mexico shoreline. So when you visit this exquisite spot, why not choose a home that places you nearly right on top of the sugar-white sand? At Atwoods Cottage & Carriage House, you simply can’t get any closer to our beautiful beach than this. With three bedrooms in the main home and a separate carriage house for that little dash of extra space that’s needed sometimes, your whole family can spread out and easily sink their toes in the sand anytime they wish.Atwoods Cottage & Carriage House was built on a slightly oversized lot, allowing for plenty of convenient parking in the garage and a large, cobblestoned courtyard between the main home and the carriage house. On the first floor of the main home are two private bedroom suites. The first room is a sitting room with a sleeper sofa and a hallway-accessed powder room, and the second is the luxurious primary bedroom suite, with a king-size bed and an attached full bathroom with a large step-in shower.Climb the classic stairway up to the main level, where the open and inviting great room is located. With multiple glass doors framing the ocean views and leading outside to the gulf-front patio, this room is ideal for relaxing indoor/outdoor living. You can open the doors wide to catch the gentle sea breezes and take your morning mug of fresh coffee outside to watch for dolphins swimming past. Inside, the vaulted ceilings and dark wood floors surround the plush furnishings and large HDTV. There’s also a large DINING SPACE with seating for four, and the whole room is illuminated with warm, artistic lighting fixtures.Next to the living area, a large marble island with barstool seating for three leads into the open kitchen. Stylish gray cabinets and sleek quartz countertops provide plenty of space for whatever you have in mind— from preparing stacks of fresh banana pancakes for your crew before they hit the beach or perhaps mixing up a pitcher of frozen margaritas before heading out to dinner. Premier appliances include a dishwasher, gas range, spacious refrigerator, and an in-drawer microwave.Another staircase leads up to the top level, where the third guest bedroom sits tucked cozily underneath the eaves. In this room, there are two queen-size beds, each with its own HDTV. The ensuite bathroom includes a large step-in shower and a marble vanity.Across the courtyard and above the garage sits the separate carriage house, an ideal space for older children or in-laws who enjoy more privacy. This flexible flat houses a full kitchen, comfy living area, full bathroom, and a peaceful bedroom with a king-size bed.Located mere inches from the beach access point, Atwoods Cottage & Carriage House is a lovely combination of luxurious oceanside estate and laidback, relaxing gulf coast vibes. This home also has six bicycles, so you can easily peddle to dinner or an afternoon ice cream cone in the charming downtown area.Home HighlightsGulf Front with amazing viewsSeparate carriage house (guest house above garage)Garage parking for two vehiclesSpacious and open layout6 Complimentary Beach Cruiser BicyclesComplete Clean Bedding ProgramFIRST FLOOR: (Sleeps 4)PRIMARY BEDROOM: king-size bed, ENSUITE BATHROOM with Shower (Sleeps 2), Open Rear BalconySITTING ROOM: Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2)COURTYARD & GARAGE PARKINGSECOND FLOOR:GREAT ROOM w/ living and dining areasKITCHENHALF BATHROOMTERRACE w/ ocean viewsTHIRD FLOOR: (Sleeps 4)GUEST BEDROOM: 2 queen-size beds, ENSUITE BATHROOM (Sleeps 4)CARRIAGE HOUSE: (Sleeps 2)KITCHENLIVING AREAGUEST BEDROOM w/king-size bed (Sleeps 2)FULL BATHROOM
